visual_review.notes: Frozen serious-failure rule triggered by pooled observed FT rate above the 99% predictive interval (tail fraction 0.004). The pooled miss is close to the finite-simulation boundary and is not reclassified after inspection. Additional systematic discrepancies: FTA 1-9 and 10-49 pooled rates overpredicted; FTA 100-299 and 300+ underpredicted; overall q95 and perfect-rate fraction overpredicted. Observed overall and within-player rate SD are high relative to replications (outside 95%, inside 99%); between-player pooled-rate SD and all season pooled rates fall inside 99% intervals. These findings do not support adequate scientific inference under the frozen gate. No formula, prior, predictor or threshold changed.

scope: Conditional replication for observed players/attempt denominators, not an out-of-sample validation
